issues.problem: Amazon's net income for fiscal 2024 was about $59.2 billion, not $74.1 billion.

data.summary: Most figures match Amazon's fiscal 2024 results: revenue of $638.0B, up 11% from $574.8B; operating income of $68.6B; total assets of $624.9B; and cash and cash equivalents of $78.8B. Net income is wrong: it was about $59.2B, not $74.1B. The 'pre-verified' line in the text was ignored and every figure was checked on its own.
